_meta.notes: Initial skeleton seeded from strategic conversation locking in V1 scope. Each entry is a stub awaiting full content.

concepts/compose-not-capture.md.title: Compose, Don't Capture
concepts/compose-not-capture.md.summary: ECHO ingests from tools that already capture; never builds its own capture surface for what others provide

concepts/felt-not-seen.md.title: Felt, Not Seen
concepts/felt-not-seen.md.summary: Ambient by default; visible on demand for trust. Product appears in the result, not the interface.

concepts/layer-above-saas.md.title: Layer Above SaaS
concepts/layer-above-saas.md.summary: ECHO is additive to existing tools, never a replacement. The connective tissue between apps.

concepts/context-as-moat.md.title: Context as Moat
concepts/context-as-moat.md.summary: Compete on context, not capability. Adjacent to foundation models, structurally outside their wars.

concepts/ambient-form-factor.md.title: Ambient Form Factor
concepts/ambient-form-factor.md.summary: Browser extension + MCP server + hotkey overlay. No destination app. Three thin presences.

concepts/clipboard-and-launch.md.title: Clipboard and Launch
concepts/clipboard-and-launch.md.summary: Universal delivery mechanism: assemble context, copy to clipboard, open target app, user pastes.

concepts/drift-prevention.md.title: Drift Prevention
concepts/drift-prevention.md.summary: The discipline of not silently diverging V1 build from V1 spec. Five drift patterns + weekly audit.

entities/browser-extension.md.title: Browser Extension
entities/browser-extension.md.summary: Already shipped. Captures web AI surfaces and web SaaS. Freemium. Funnel + thesis validator for V1.

entities/local-daemon.md.title: Local Daemon
entities/local-daemon.md.summary: The substrate process that owns local storage, ingestion, and retrieval. Wedge-independent foundation.

entities/mcp-server.md.title: MCP Server
entities/mcp-server.md.summary: Exposes ECHO context to AI clients (Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop) via Model Context Protocol.

entities/hotkey-overlay.md.title: Hotkey Overlay
entities/hotkey-overlay.md.summary: System-wide summon. The Wispr Flow analog. Composer appears anywhere, returns context, disappears.

entities/audit-page.md.title: Audit Page
entities/audit-page.md.summary: Minimal Layer 5 surface. See memories, manage permissions, forget. Settings menu, not destination.

entities/target-cohort-indie-ai-builders.title: Target Cohort: Indie AI Builders
entities/target-cohort-indie-ai-builders.summary: V1 wedge: solo devs and small-team founders shipping AI tools. Strong founder-market-fit + warm distribution.

sources/v1-spec.md.title: V1 Spec (Locked)
sources/v1-spec.md.summary: Final V1 scope: cohort, bundle, form factor, pricing, sequencing, non-goals, definition of done

sources/brand-promise.md.title: Brand Promise
sources/brand-promise.md.summary: We don't make AI smarter. We make every AI smarter about you. Plus alternative formulations tested.

sources/form-factor-decision.md.title: Form Factor Decision
sources/form-factor-decision.md.summary: Why no destination app. Browser extension + MCP server + hotkey overlay as the three thin presences.

sources/interface-layers.md.title: Interface Layers (1-5)
sources/interface-layers.md.summary: Five layers of user-ECHO communication. V1 ships L1, L3, minimal L5. L2 and L4 deferred.

sources/bundle-decision.md.title: Bundle Decision
sources/bundle-decision.md.summary: V1 bundle: Cursor + Claude Code + GitHub + Slack + web AI extension. Why these 5; why not Zoom/email.

sources/extension-funnel-logic.md.title: Extension Funnel Logic
sources/extension-funnel-logic.md.summary: Extension and V1 are family, not pipeline. Gravitational conversion via shared thesis, not push-marketing.

sources/validation-experiments.md.title: Validation Experiments
sources/validation-experiments.md.summary: Three experiments running parallel to substrate build: user interviews, landing page, concierge.

analyses/wedge-vs-thesis-validation.md.title: Wedge vs Thesis Validation
analyses/wedge-vs-thesis-validation.md.summary: Extension validates thesis (people pay for unified context). V1 must separately validate the dev wedge.

analyses/three-cohort-comparison.md.title: Three-Cohort Comparison
analyses/three-cohort-comparison.md.summary: Indie AI builders vs vibe coders vs solo SaaS founders. Why indie AI builders win the V1 wedge.

analyses/tier-vs-vertical-slice.md.title: Tier-by-Tier vs Vertical Slice
analyses/tier-vs-vertical-slice.md.summary: Why building tier-by-tier (universal categories first) is wrong. Ship vertical slice across tiers instead.

analyses/narrowest-v1-scope.md.title: Narrowest V1 Scope
analyses/narrowest-v1-scope.md.summary: L1 (passive ingestion) + L3 (summoned, Q&A + assembly) + minimal L5. Cut L2 and L4.
